summary: Iteration 4 testing (dynamic sitemap/robots, portfolio Quick View drawer, SEO meta/JSON-LD, Category CMS with cascade rename + visibility + reorder, dynamic homepage portfolio filter). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py — 9/9 new tests pass; full regression across iter1+2+3+4 = 47/47 passed in 44s. Verified: (a) GET /api/sitemap.xml returns application/xml with 1 homepage <loc> + 8 published services + 6 published portfolio (15 <loc> total); draft service is excluded from XML. (b) GET /api/robots.txt returns text/plain with 'Disallow: /admin' and 'Sitemap: <base>/api/sitemap.xml'. (c) GET /api/categories returns 6 default categories (Packaging, Logo, Sticker, Landing Page, Marketplace, Motion) sorted by order, only visible=true. (d) Admin category CRUD: unauthenticated GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/reorder all → 401; rename cascade — created TestCat_IT4, created a draft portfolio in it, PUT rename → TestCatRenamed_IT4, GET /api/portfolio/{slug} confirmed category updated; visibility toggle removes from public list but keeps in admin; reorder categories with reversed ids returns {ok:true} and public GET reflects new order. All cleanup performed (temp cat & portfolio deleted, Motion visibility restored, category order restored). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): homepage / — <link rel='canonical'>, og:title, og:image and JSON-LD @type Organization all present. /services/packaging-design — document.title = 'Packaging Design — Veyora Creative Studio', canonical link present, JSON-LD @type Service present with provider Organization. Homepage /#portfolio filters generated from /api/categories: ['Semua','Packaging','Logo','Sticker','Landing Page','Marketplace','Motion']. Clicking a portfolio card opens the side drawer [data-testid=portfolio-drawer] (not a navigation); 'Lihat Studi Kasus Lengkap' [data-testid=portfolio-drawer-full-case] has href='/portfolio/kopi-nusantara'; close button dismisses the drawer. Filtering by 'Logo' narrows to 1 matching item. Admin login OK → 'Kategori' tab [data-testid=admin-tab-categories] opens [data-testid=panel-categories]; added a new visible category (category-add → category-name → category-save) that appeared on homepage filter list after reload ('TEST_UICat_IT4' in filters). Visibility toggle button [data-testid=category-toggle-<slug>] present per row. Portfolio editor Kategori is <select data-testid='portfolio-category'> populated from managed categories (Packaging, Logo, Sticker, Landing Page, Marketplace, Motion). All temp UI-created data cleaned up (DELETE 200).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_category slug regenerates from name every PUT — a manual custom slug is preserved only if passed explicitly; documented behavior but worth noting for future admin flows.

server.py delete_category does NOT cascade to portfolio items still using that category — those items are left with an orphaned category string (silent inconsistency). Consider either (a) reject delete if portfolio references exist, (b) reassign to a default, or (c) surface warning in UI. Current UI confirmation just warns 'Portfolio dengan kategori ini tidak akan terhapus' which is accurate but the orphaned category won't show in dynamic filters.

server.py sitemap uses PUBLIC_BASE_URL from env but has no fallback — if unset, <loc> becomes '/', '/services/…' (relative). Fine currently (env set), but could add fallback to request.base_url for robustness.
Carried from prior iterations: PUT /admin/{services,portfolio,faqs,categories}/{id} still use upsert=True — unknown id creates a new doc instead of returning 404.
Carried from iter2: upload endpoint validates only extension, not file bytes/magic-number.
Carried from iter3: ImageUpload preview may still emit 'empty string was passed to src' console warning when value is empty.
